The Intelligence lens uses only authoritative organization and approved analytical records/layers with source, visibility, geography, vintage, quality, caveat and coverage truth, exactly four governed actions and server-enforced private/team/organization/public scopes.

Menu/Account provides role-appropriate referral overview, records and policy management while payment/payout/report surfaces remain absent or truthfully unavailable unless backed by separately authorized authoritative domains.

Menu/Account remains outside market-lens navigation, exposes only implemented currently authorized utilities, returns to prior safe Exchange context and applies server-authoritative permission, dependency, confirmation, failure and audit controls to destructive operations.

Every enabled lens or record action performs a real authorized workflow with loading, validation, success feedback, recoverable error, idempotency where repeatable, current resulting state and safe detail/Exchange return; navigation-only placeholders remain disabled.

Notifications arise only from real domain events, honor current participant preferences and authorization, preserve organization isolation and never imply a payment, payout, match, outcome or lifecycle state absent authoritative evidence.

The existing organization-centered registration, geography, claim/create, authority, essential profile, marker, orientation, first-value and OPEN journey converges on Capabilities as the fourth lens, then offers progressive core details, geography/locations, directory/team, capability profile, Resources, Intelligence, Opportunities readiness, referral policy, preferences/alerts and progress overview without making optional enrichment, provider status, Verification or payment a general Exchange-entry gate.

Legitimate free organization participation and Exchange entry remain available before optional post-value Founding conversion; commercial status never alters authority, verification, credibility, qualification, neutral discovery or matching, and paid referral fees/payouts require separate Critical authority.

The integrated final architecture passes mobile/desktop, touch/pointer/keyboard, reduced-motion, accessibility, five-locale, cross-lens, security/privacy/tenant, migration, performance, clean-console and configured-browser acceptance with no material unresolved finding.

Current main, exact-head and post-merge CI, configured-browser evidence, risk-based release authorization, existing Firebase App Hosting deployment, rollback/containment and production-safe smoke tests prove the Stage 6 release without claiming Stabilization 2C or optional independent assurance.

The product-owner Stage 3–6 architecture, immutable sixteen-action registry, legacy successor dispositions, dependency-safe work packets, free-entry commercial boundary and release constraints are codified in repository authority before successor runtime implementation begins.
